items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: for example, uh, Early Lopez, Paul Whiteman, Ben Pollack... were there, and any kid could go around from place to place if he were minded to, and just hang around outside and listen all night long to these bands.

ctx.x: Uh, I know there are a lot of things we haven't covered along that line, but I did want to get a little bit about, uh, your life down. It's, uh, it's a matter of record how much research you've done here, maybe a dissertation, copy of it over there. But, uh, first thing I'd like to ask anybody is when they were born and where, if you don't mind.

I was born in, uh, 1915, November 3rd, in upstate New York, Saratoga Springs, New York. And, uh, that was a city which was a summer resort for many, many years. Uh, in fact, uh, pre-Civil War days, it was one of the common resorts of, uh, wealthy New Orleanians, uh, to go to Saratoga. And Edna Ferber's novel, Saratoga Trump, you know, it's a lane between New Orleans and Saratoga Springs.
